result.title: BISECT: Bilevel Spectral Decomposition for Low-Rank Continual Learning
result.summary: Exemplar-free continual learning on pre-trained Vision Transformers increasingly relies on Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), yet prevailing methods govern the low-rank update space through strict subspace isolation. By projecting each incoming task into the approximate null space of historical token activations, isolation-based learners equate any cross-task feature overlap with catastrophic interference. We show that this orthogonality premise induces a structural bottleneck we term \emph{spectral starvation}: when down-projection bases are locked before task optimization, the gradient norm reaching the trainable up-projection is upper-bounded by the energy of current-task features captured by the chosen basis. Because natural visual tasks share low- and mid-level covariance structure, historical null tails contain barely $5.5\%$ of incoming task variance, starving new-class plasticity while blocking positive consolidation along shared directions. We propose BISECT (Bilevel Spectral Decomposition), a continual LoRA framework that partitions a fixed rank-$r$ budget into two orthogonal functional blocks: an invariant carrier spanned by the dominant modes of the joint historical-and-current Gram matrix, and a novelty complement extracted via generalized Rayleigh whitening followed by orthogonal complement projection. After single-task training, BISECT folds both blocks back into the frozen backbone using a closed-form precision gate that scales each rank-1 invariant atom by its current-to-joint Rayleigh ratio while preserving novelty atoms at unit gain. Across eight incremental settings on ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and DomainNet, BISECT outperforms prompt, adapter, and LoRA baselines with zero extra inference parameters or FLOPs, and remains complementary to sparse analytic expansion.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对预训练 ViT 上的无样本持续学习 LoRA，指出严格子空间隔离会导致「spectral starvation」，即历史零空间仅覆盖新任务约 5.5% 方差、限制可塑性；据此提出 BISECT，把固定秩预算拆成由联合 Gram 矩阵主模态张成的不变载体块与经广义 Rayleigh 白化提取的新颖补块，训练后用闭式精度门控折回主干，在多个增量基准上优于 prompt、adapter 与 LoRA 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其激活 Gram 谱、低秩更新空间容量分配与梯度范数上界的分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 工作区的秩预算划分、共享与新颖方向取舍以及信息坍缩诊断提供可供核查的线索；但原文面向参数持续学习，未涉及推理期 latent 状态的生成与使用。
